title_zh: 树木通过真菌网络“对话”
reveal_en: Beneath forest floors, trees "communicate" and share resources like nutrients and water through vast, intricate underground networks of fungi, sometimes called the "Wood Wide Web."
reveal_zh: 在森林地表之下，树木通过庞大复杂的地下真菌网络“交流”，共享养分和水，这被称为“木头万维网”。
meaning_en: This reveals a hidden, cooperative intelligence in nature, challenging our individualistic view of plants.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了自然界中隐秘的合作智慧，颠覆了我们对植物的个体化认知。

visual.motion: Underground fungal threads subtly pulsing with light, roots intertwining.
